request: I need a contact form I can put on any page with a shortcode. Visitors enter name, email and a message. Save every submission in the database and send me an email about it. In the admin I want a page that lists all the messages, newest first, with a delete button for each one.

Testimonials plugin. Visitors can send a testimonial from a form on the site: name, company, text and a star rating. I approve them in the admin before they show. Show the approved ones with a shortcode that accepts a count and a layout (grid or list).
A live search box through a shortcode. While people type, show matching posts and pages under the box without reloading the page. Let me choose which post types are searched in the plugin settings.

Newsletter signup form as a shortcode and as a widget. Save the emails in their own database table, stop duplicates, and give me an admin page with the list, a delete link per row and an export to CSV button.
File download manager. I upload files in the admin. A shortcode like [download id="3"] shows a download button. Count the downloads and show the count next to each file in the admin list.

I have a price list that my mobile app needs. Add REST API endpoints to list the items, read one item, and add, update and delete items, stored in a custom database table. The admin also needs a settings page where I can manage the same items.
Simple poll plugin. I create polls in the admin with several answers. Visitors vote through AJAX, one vote per IP address, and then see the results as bars. Shortcode to place a poll on a page.
Events plugin with a custom post type for events: date, time, location, and a link to a map. A shortcode [events] lists upcoming events and can filter by category and limit the number shown.

Reviews for posts. Visitors send a star rating and a text through AJAX on a single post. Show the average rating and the list of reviews under the post automatically. The admin can delete reviews from a list page.

Redirect manager. In the admin I add rows with a source URL, a target URL and a type (301 or 302), and I can import many rows from a CSV file. The plugin does the redirects on the front end and counts how many times each one was used.

A plugin to export my site options to a JSON file and import them on another site from an uploaded file. Show a list of the options with checkboxes so I can choose which ones go into the export, and which ones are applied on import.

Image gallery shortcode with columns, image size, captions, link target and a lightbox. Something like [tinygallery ids="1,2,3" columns="3" class="my-gallery" link="file"]. Keep the lightbox simple, no external libraries.

Maintenance and coming soon mode. In the admin I switch it on and set a title, a message that can contain HTML, a background image and an optional countdown date. Logged-in admins still see the normal site. Also a secret URL key that lets me show the site to a client.

Social share buttons added after the post content, with options for which networks to show. Also a shortcode [share url="" title=""] to use anywhere. Count the clicks per network and show the totals in the admin.

FAQ plugin with an accordion. In the admin I add questions and answers as a custom post type with categories. A shortcode shows them grouped by category with open and close animation, and the page also outputs the schema.org FAQ markup.
Let me paste custom scripts and CSS into the header and the footer of the site, with a per-page override in a box on the edit screen, and a switch to turn it off on selected pages.

Extra fields on user profiles: phone, company, short bio and a profile picture upload. Users edit them on their profile page in the admin and also on the front end with a shortcode [profile_form]. Show the phone and company as columns in the users list.

Database backup tool. A button in the admin exports the tables I tick to an SQL file in the uploads folder. A list shows the past backups with download and delete. Add an option for a scheduled daily backup using cron.

Appointment booking. Visitors pick a date and time in a form and enter their details. I get an email with Approve and Decline links. The customer gets a confirmation email. Admin page with the list of bookings and their statuses.

Login tools: custom redirect after login and logout per user role, limit login attempts per IP address with a lockout time, an option to move the login page to a custom slug, and an admin page with a log of the failed logins.
